title: Simul Parul
desc: Simul, Rajani's son, falls in love with Parul. However, Parul's father disapproves of their relationship because of his complicated history with Rajani.

title: 100 Percent Love
desc: Competitive peers Balu and Mahalakshmi have ego clashes while in college. When they meet again after a few years, they try to outdo each other until they realise that they are in love.

title: Pradhan
desc: When an honest policeman is transferred to Dharmapur, he encounters widespread corruption and fights to stay true to his principles.

title: Abhimanyu
desc: Raj Sinha, a policeman, kills gangster Durjo Rai's son in an encounter. He soon asks Abhimanyu, a suspended colleague, to protect the last two members of his family from Rai.
